name: USD/JPY & Interest Rate Differential Analysis
description: Research study analyzing how the US-Japan 10-year interest rate differential has historically driven USD/JPY. Loads daily USD/JPY FX data, US 10Y Treasury yield (DGS10), and Japan 10Y government bond yield (IRLTLT01JPM156N). Computes rolling 60-day and 252-day Pearson correlations between the rate differential and USD/JPY level. Outputs include: (1) USD/JPY price and rate differential time series, (2) rolling correlation chart (60d and 252d), (3) scatter plot of rate differential vs USD/JPY with regression line, and (4) summary table with full-period correlation, beta, R-squared, current rate differential, and current USD/JPY.
source:
# USD/JPY & Interest Rate Differential Analysis
# Examines how the US-Japan 10Y yield spread drives USD/JPY
# Key question: Does a wider rate differential correspond to a stronger dollar vs yen?

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# USD/JPY daily price
src_fx = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src_fx.c

# US 10-Year Treasury Yield (daily, %)
us10y = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
yield_us = ffill(us10y.result)

# Japan 10-Year Government Bond Yield (monthly, %)
jp10y = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
yield_jp = ffill(jp10y.result)

# ============================================================================
# RATE DIFFERENTIAL
# ============================================================================

# US 10Y minus Japan 10Y (in percentage points)
rate_diff = yield_us - yield_jp

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATIONS (Levels-Based)
# ============================================================================

# 60-day rolling Pearson correlation: rate differential vs USD/JPY level
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)

# 252-day (annual) rolling Pearson correlation
corr_252d = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)

# Expanding (full-period) correlation for summary stats
corr_expanding = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)

# R-squared = correlation squared
r_squared = corr_expanding * corr_expanding

# ============================================================================
# BETA: USD/JPY change per 1% rate differential change (Rolling OLS)
# ============================================================================

# Rolling OLS with 500-day window as best approximation for long-term beta
ols_fit = linear_fit(window=500)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)
beta = ols_fit.slope

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: USD/JPY Price & Rate Differential (separate panels)
# ============================================================================

# USD/JPY price level
xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY Price Level',
    category='1. Rate Differential & USD/JPY',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=close_fx, y_values=close_fx)

# Rate differential overlay (separate chart for clarity due to different scales)
xy_lines(
    title='US-Japan 10Y Rate Differential (%)',
    category='1. Rate Differential & USD/JPY',
    y_axis_label='Rate Differential (%)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 10Y - JP 10Y', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=rate_diff, y_values=rate_diff)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: Rolling Correlations (Levels-Based, 60d & 252d)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Correlation: Rate Differential vs USD/JPY (Levels-Based)',
    category='2. Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252-Day', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='Moderate +', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, title='Moderate -', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=corr_60d, y_values=(corr_60d, corr_252d))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: Scatter — Rate Differential vs USD/JPY with Regression Line
# ============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title='Rate Differential vs USD/JPY (All Daily Observations)',
    category='3. Scatter Analysis',
    x_axis_label='US-Japan 10Y Rate Differential (%)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=0
)(x=rate_diff, y_values=close_fx)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Key Statistics
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='USD/JPY & Rate Differential Summary',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Full-Period Correlation', 'Beta (JPY per 1% Differential)', 'R-Squared', 'Current Rate Differential (%)', 'Current USD/JPY'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Summary Statistics',
    order=0
)(corr_expanding, beta, r_squared, rate_diff, close_fx)
